title: Optical Neural Networks Should Be Evaluated by Function, Not Only Physics
abstract: arXiv:2611.23610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy?   This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. translated_title: 光学神经网络应当按功能而非仅按物理来评估
translated_abstract: 光学神经网络（ONN）作为机器学习（ML）的替代平台正受到广泛关注。在光学神经网络中，光学模块通常接管数字机器学习流水线中的部分计算。那么，光学模块本身到底完成了任务的多少部分，它又对所声称的系统级优势（如吞吐量或能耗）贡献了多少？本文提出了一种简单的、面向功能的评估方法。无论其内部物理机制如何，光学模块对周围的数字流水线而言都表现为实值张量之间的映射。因此，我们分三步对其进行评估：(i) 定义其在流水线中的边界，即以实值张量为输入和输出；(ii) 用标准数字模块替换它，以找出在同一任务和相同指标下能与光学系统性能匹配的模块；(iii) 针对性能匹配的基线，按每次推理来陈述系统级主张，如速度或能耗。
tldr: 本文提出一种面向功能的三步评估方法，通过将光学神经网络模块与性能匹配的标准数字模块进行对比，来客观衡量其对系统级优势（如速度和能耗）的真实贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a function-oriented three-step evaluation methodology that benchmarks optical neural network modules against performance-matched standard digital modules to objectively assess their claimed system-level advantages such as speed and energy efficiency.
